reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by sonhoai27/basil-ui (https://github.com/sonhoai27/basil-ui).
Technology stack: react, radix-ui, tailwind, typescript.
Component specification: 具体条目内容细节展示。

Visual details from source observation: README 目录从 What is Basil? 一路排到 Highlights / Install / Quick start / Design principles (v2) / Components / For AI agents / Develop / Contributing / Roadmap / License。根目录里能看到 registry.json、components.json、llms.txt 与 llms-full.txt、mcp 目录，还有 .ladle 和 AGENTS.md。话题标签打了 components、dashboard、design-system、pos、radix、react、shadcn、tailwindcss、typescript、ui；最新版本是 v0.2.0 — i18n + charts，仓库目前只有 1 个 star。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
